# Claim And Evidence Rules

Use one of six labels:

| Label            | Meaning                                    | Citation rule                                          |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------ |
| `fact`           | Statement represented in approved evidence | At least one valid evidence ID required                |
| `assumption`     | Unverified premise used for analysis       | No citation implies explicit validation needed         |
| `unknown`        | Required information is absent             | Identify owner or next question when known             |
| `risk`           | Potential adverse condition                | Cite evidence when the risk derives from a source      |
| `recommendation` | Proposed next action or design             | Cite supporting evidence and state conditions          |
| `decision`       | Authorized selection or disposition        | Cite the authoritative human record and exact revision |

Never convert an assumption into a fact because it sounds likely. Never cite a mutable URL when an immutable evidence record is available.
